contract.selection: Explicit actor profile.first_room_race_variant true only. Default entry/bank, original codex, portraits, skill icons and original action files unchanged.
contract.scale_rule: Fixed body pixel/world ratio per identity across all poses; source absolute foot anchors compensate harmless cell-position variation. Do not normalize alpha bbox independently per pose.
contract.walk: Existing runtime motion with idle key pose; not a new full walking animation.
contract.recovery: Idle key pose with existing runtime transformation.
contract.m04_execute_semantics: Interruptible sustained healing channel, original target restrictions retained.
contract.collision_damage: Body variants are presentation only; navigation radius, collision, damage, timing, roster IDs and progression unchanged.
contract.ui: New body variants are not automatically used in old codex/portrait/skill UI.
contract.color: Original generated PNG colors retained by native source-body presentation.
contract.directional_coverage: Canonical right-facing key poses plus runtime horizontal mirroring; no new eight-direction animation coverage.

source_qa.checked: Human faces and separate vine-whip/sprout-cannon/flower-speaker roles; all three poses fully contained in separate cells; alpha>=16 no edge crossing or outer clipping; planted-foot registration inspected.
source_qa.runtime_2k_conclusion: Pending actual L25 production-frame verification at 2560x1440. Source-pixel QA alone is not runtime acceptance.
source_qa.budget_note: A conservative verification budget, not a forced 2K source size. Actual measured screen occupancy must be recorded by integration test. Native ordinary-body height is clamped to 66-88 world pixels then multiplied by 1.20; viewport camera fitting determines final pixels.

Entire weapon loop/staff/extended sleeve must also stay locally x50–368, absolutely never x<50 or x>368. Most important is entirely isolated three sprites with truly transparent gaps, NOT huge figures filling the canvas. Transparent background alpha retained. Keep species role: adult leaf-crowned human-faced vinewhip warden with a THIN coiled living vine.
Original design brief to retain:
Create production game character sprite art, one PNG with real transparent background, square 1254x1254 canvas. The PNG is exactly THREE separate equal vertical columns, each column 418 pixels wide, in ONE row; no grid lines, letters or labels. Three full-body key poses of the SAME identifiable plant-spirit humanoid adult vine-whip warden: left idle, middle attack anticipation, right whip release. She/he must look like the elegant living botanical people of an aerial giant-tree city, not a bird, ent, wooden armored golem, waterdrop, or monster mask: clearly visible pale cream HUMAN FACE, pointed plant ears, almond eyes, gold-edged sage-green leaf crown, slim mature human limbs, flowing layered jade and olive leaf clothing, pink blossom details, slender brown vine belt, warm gold trim. Bright painterly storybook fantasy 2.5D at elevated three-quarter camera, consistently facing right, refined readable outline, natural painted material detail, original colors green cream pink gold.

STRICT atlas composition: each full figure AND all weapon parts remain only within its own 418px column, with at least 40px transparent empty side borders. Each humanoid is deliberately narrow, same anatomy size across poses, crown approximately y=260, both feet grounded around y=1040. No image part may touch the outer canvas or column boundary. Body anatomy around 760 pixels tall, actual visible figure no taller than 820px, with large transparent top/bottom margins. The left and middle and right feet have exactly corresponding local positions in their cells. Full entire plant-shoe feet visible, same base anatomy and camera. Compact whip arranged vertically beside each body, never long horizontally: idle coiled living vine hanging beside hip; middle same vine arm winding a narrow high curved vine loop; right extended arm to right with a short tightly curving vine snap fully INSIDE cell. Distinct readable keyposes but no large change in body's stance or scale. Face and outfit are identical between cells. Weapon must be thin and natural, never an enormous trunk arm. No drawn hit effect or projectile, no magical root spears, no ground shadow, no pedestal, no background, no border, no checkerboard baked in. This is actual transparent RGBA sprite artwork with crisp readable small-game silhouette.
